text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 19, 2024) for 2 Prospect Street.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 19, 2024) for 2 Prospect Street, Folder Number 24 215076 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to June 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
